props.text: Gateway events · Python without an open browser
Open Designer → Scripting. Seven disabled examples are included. Review each one, enable deliberately, save, then Publish scripts. Publishing this screen does not activate the scripts.

LIFECYCLE
Startup records activation. Update records an author and changed resources. Shutdown records an orderly stop when the host has time to finish.

TIMING
Timer starts at a 10-second fixed delay. Scheduled runs every five minutes in UTC. Inspect next-run times in Gateway events diagnostics.

TAG CHANGE
For this optional exercise, create a memory tag at [default]Workshop/GatewayEvents/Counter. Enable the observer, then change that test tag. The script only records its values.

MESSAGES
Enable and publish Workshop echo. Send a JSON object with Test published handler in Scripting. The administrator-only handler echoes it to Result.

OBSERVE
Gateway events shows active work, next runs and the latest 100 run logs across restarts. Cancellation stops remaining work; it cannot undo completed actions.
I reviewed the scripts and their triggers before publishing
Synthetic examples only. No device commands, database writes, connections or credentials. This checkbox is local browser state.
